notes.title: A 75% discount will be available for 5 days starting March 30
notes.content:
Hello.
Due to the current situation with COVID-19, we have decided to offer a discount to give you a little more pleasure. We are offering a 75% discount for 5 days (US Pacific Time) from March 30 to April 3.

We hope many of you will be able to play the game without any burden during this discount period.

Above all, we wish you to stay healthy and overcome this difficult time without any problems.

Thanks,
ReFrame

notes.title: New Features! A rift in time, Achievements
notes.content:
Hello.
We're happy to bring you some interesting news. :)
The following items have been added / changed!

[olist]
[*]A rift in time
[*]Achivement
[*]Stage modification
[/olist]


[h3][b]1. A rift in time[/b][/h3]
The upcoming update will add a new feature, 'a rift in time!'
The rift in time is an obstacle, an object that makes you restart a stage when the character gets close. Of course, it is safe in the same colored area made by lantern. And it looks like this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257127/f35d2dc2989078616791e3961588c44bc92f1e27.png[/img]

It's also deployed in episodes 1 and 2 that have already been released, so you'll be able to get a new feeling. :) Try to avoid it in time and go on your journey!


[h3][b]2. Achivement[/b][/h3]
Finally, we're happy to show achievements. There are currently 5 published achievements, but there will be approximately 15~20 achievements in the upcoming full release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257127/25ee1a80ee7df8ec935df2657954104e425e3fcb.png[/img]


[h3][b]3. Stage modification[/b][/h3]
We have modified several stages that are not balanced against difficulty with the addition of a rift in time. 

The 3rd episode is currently being worked and tested due to a setback in the development schedule. We'll be back with a full release as soon as possible.

Thank you for always waiting and we hope you stay healthy and safe.

Sincerely,
ReFrame

notes.title: Steam VR (HTC VIVE) Support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36257127/f6de01bcde3fa1726bef46ce5047bf7ad77db717.jpg[/img]

Hello.

We finally show the Steam VR (HTC VIVE) support to you. :)

Unlike the Thumbstick of the Oculus Rift, you can move to the circular pad buttons on the left controller. You can control the lantern with the circular pad button on the right controller.

Thank you always for waiting, and we will welcome your feedback at any time :)

Thank you.

ReFrame
